items.title: Allstate (ALL) Takes Full Ownership Of A Mobility Data Company
items.summary: Allstate (NYSE:ALL) subsidiary Arity is acquiring the remaining ownership interest in mobility intelligence firm Replica. Replica focuses on data and technology for mobility insights that can inform insurance product design and risk assessment. Arity plans to fully integrate Replica's mobility data capabilities into its existing analytics-focused operations. Arity's move to take full control of Replica fits into a broader technology push that recent research on Allstate has highlighted. Our...
